errors.text_span: 该图表呈现了两个饼图，展示了不同类别的分布。
errors.evidence: Figure shows one large pie chart on the left connected to a separate exploded/detail pie chart on the right, not two independent pie charts showing different distributions.

These labels/colors are assigned to the wrong categories. In the figure, the left pie contains 生活工作 74.74%, 生理活动 10.56%, 其他 5.64%, 身体动作 2.38%, 判断 4.06%, 表情 2.62%, and the right pie contains categories such as 争斗, 方位改变, 管理, 际遇, 交通, 经贸, 社交, 生产, 帮助, 司法, 文教, 物态事态, 心理活动, 战争. Several labels listed here do not correspond to the shown left-pie slices, and the right-pie categories are not matched correctly.

The figure shows 15 categories in total only if counting all labeled slices across both linked pies, but the description then omits one category from the right pie and inconsistently states 13 subcategories; the count is not reliably represented.

errors.text_span: 较小的饼图进一步将剩余的类别细分为13个子类别：争斗（2.93%，紫色）、方位改变（9.85%，橙色）、管理（4.13%，棕色）、际遇（0.27%，浅棕色）、交通（1.6%，灰棕色）、经贸（0.33%，淡紫色）、社交（15.44%，浅粉色）、生产（2.06%，青色）和帮助（2.93%，黄色）。
errors.evidence: The right-side pie includes 13 categories, but only 9 are listed here; several visible categories are missing, including 司法（14.57%）, 文教（10.98%）, 物态事态（6.72%）, 心理活动（15.44%）, and 战争（0.6%）. Also '帮助' is 2.93% in the figure, but the color is orange, not yellow.
The description does not mention the exploded/offset connection between the two pies, which is a prominent visual feature of the figure.
The description omits several visible right-pie categories: 司法, 文教, 物态事态, 心理活动, and 战争.
As a pie chart there are no axes, so no axis description is needed.
